name: Thumbtack
summary: Pin buttons on a cork board: notes fly to the top and a pushpin drops in with a jolt and a puff of dust
about: A home cork board with six sticky notes held on with tape, each with its own pin toggle. Pinning lifts the note, peels its tape, flies it along an arc to the front while the others shuffle along, then drops a pushpin onto it so the paper jolts, cork dust puffs and the pin head wobbles. Unpinning wiggles the pin loose and pops it out spinning, leaves a little hole and lets the paper flutter back to its place under fresh tape.
how: Press the pin button on a note (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space) to pin it.
The note moves to the front of the board and the newest pin goes first; the counter rolls up.
Press the red pin button on a pinned note to unpin it and send it back to its place.
Keyboard focus stays on the button while the note moves, so you can pin and unpin in a row.
